question.text: A newly-launched Cat III AIF, Aravalli Long-Short Fund, had its First Close on 1-August 2024. On what date (earliest) must it start reporting data to the benchmarking agency under SEBI's framework?

answer.text: After completing one year from First Close, i.e., from 1-Aug-2025 onwards (reporting from the next half-yearly date, 30-Sep-2025)
After three years from First Close, i.e., 1-Aug-2027

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI's operational guideline, AIFs/Schemes that have completed at least one year from First Close shall provide the necessary information/data to the Benchmarking Agencies. Half-yearly benchmarking reporting dates are September 30 and March 31. First Close on 1-Aug-2024 means one year is completed on 1-Aug-2025, so the first reporting date is the next half-yearly cut-off, i.e., 30-Sep-2025. The Trap: Options A and B jump the gun — SEBI requires at least one year of fund history before peer comparability. Option D (3 years) confuses with PE/VC vintage-year reporting conventions, not Cat III. Note: Pages 222-223 of the workbook set the one-year-from-First-Close rule and the September 30 / March 31 half-yearly benchmarking reporting dates.
